annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Victorian Information Commissioner (OVIC)
key_provisions_or_claims: VPS organisations should not enter personal information into publicly available generative AI tools.
Only publicly known or approved-for-release public sector information may be entered.
Generated personal information counts as a new collection under the Information Privacy Principles.
Public tools should not be used to make decisions or assessments affecting individuals.
Organisations must run security risk assessments, set policies, train staff, check accuracy and notify OVIC of incidents.
named_instruments_referenced: Victorian Privacy and Data Protection Act 2014
Victorian Administrative guideline on safe and responsible use of GenAI
annotation.summary_en: OVIC guidance (version 2.1, June 2026) on Victorian public sector use of publicly available generative AI tools. It says personal information must not be entered, limits public sector information, explains the Information Privacy Principle risks, sets minimum expectations such as risk assessments, policies, training and incident notification, and gives illustrative scenarios.
annotation.title_clean: Use of publicly available Generative AI tools in the Victorian public sector
